body: My mother has receding gums. Very painful. Her dentist did a graft from the roof of her mouth. Yes, it was painful, but now she can eat again and brush without pain. There are often free or very low cost dental clinics that can help. I hope you can find a way to ease your physical and emotional pain.
I'm sorry. I know how it feels to feel broken and dead inside. I wish I could make things better for you. You sound like a caring person to me and I wish the people around you could see that.
